ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-29-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change of a minor.

Dept. 514, Judge: Paul H. Alvarado, Clerks: s.Vantree and J. Murphy, CSR: Mitch Lyon, #6840

Petitioner Altmaa Tudevdagva mother of minor present in court.

Petitioner Altmaa Tudevdagva sworn and examined.

Proof of Publication on file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from Munkhjin Jordan Enkhtur to Jordan Munkhjin Enkhtur.

Decree Changing Name signed in open cour
